description: Every economic statement in every TTP must have full provenance.
format: claim → source → date → calculation → uncertainty → buyer-specific dependency → status

entries.calculation: Literature review of shunt failure modes
entries.uncertainty: ±10% (varies by shunt type, patient age, follow-up duration)
entries.buyer_dependency: Buyer's specific patient population and shunt model may differ

entries.source: Industry estimates for shunt revision surgery (hospital + surgeon + imaging + follow-up)
entries.buyer_dependency: Buyer's actual cost structure, reimbursement rates, complication rates

entries.claim: >60% of NPH patients have Alzheimer's comorbidity
entries.calculation: Post-mortem and biomarker studies showing AD pathology in NPH patients

entries.source: Industry estimates for implantable battery replacement

entries.calculation: Based on development cost saved + economic value delivered + rights granted
entries.buyer_dependency: Buyer's budget, perceived value, competitive alternatives
